title: Tool Manifest
description: Declares a host tool that can be auto-installed by the Vrooli runtime

storage.description: Portable declaration of the tool's on-disk storage surface.

retention.description: Declared storage ceilings for the runtime data this tool accumulates. Enforced by packages/api-core/retention. Distinct from durable_data, which declares what to back up.

name.description: Unique tool identifier matching the handler registry name

commands.description: Command names to check on PATH (first match wins)

versionArgs.description: Arguments passed to the resolved command to extract version output

defaultPackage.description: Fallback package name when the host package manager is not listed in packages

packages.description: Per-package-manager package name overrides (e.g. apt, brew, winget, dnf, pacman, apk). When source is url/release, the matching verified target is preferred and this package is the fallback when no target exists for the host OS/architecture.

installHint.description: Human-readable install guidance shown when the tool is missing

platforms.description: Platforms this tool applies to. Omit for all platforms.

handler.description: Name of a custom Go handler. When set, the generic package-install logic is bypassed.

capability.description: Capability delivered by this tool; values are governed by .vrooli/capability-vocabulary.json.

capability_role.description: Whether this is the primary implementation, a platform peer, or a required host control for the capability.

manual.description: When true, this tool has no automatic install path (e.g. a pip CLI or a from-source build). The runtime surfaces it as manual-action-required with installHint rather than attempting a fetch/package install.

privilege.description: Optional override for the privilege derived from the install mechanism; privilegeReason is required when set.

privilegeReason.description: Why this tool's explicit privilege overrides the source-mechanism derivation.

bundling.description: Whether the tool may be included in a Tier 2 desktop bundle.

acquisition.description: Fact-predicated, checksum-verified acquisition targets shared by tools and resources.

requires.description: Hardware-capability gate evaluated against host inventory (GPU/VRAM/arch/RAM). When any condition is unmet the tool is cleanly skipped (not applicable), never failed.

gpu.description: Require (true) or forbid (false) a detected GPU

minVramGb.description: Minimum total VRAM in GiB on at least one detected GPU

arch.description: Allowed host architectures (Go GOARCH, e.g. amd64, arm64)

minRamGb.description: Minimum total system RAM in GiB

verificationCheck.description: Optional post-install verification. If absent, command presence on PATH is sufficient.

notes.description: Freeform annotation for maintainers (not shown to users during install)
